title: SP-HLM: Sparse-Pose-Driven Motion Generation and Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

release_status.verification: Official organization public repository list contains the project website only; fixed site HTML links to videos, method and results, without explicit implementation, checkpoint or full training-data download links. Not a claim that no other release exists.
release_status.direct_site_access: Timed out; official GitHub Pages source HTML reviewed

evidence_boundaries: High-level output is five 9D world poses plus 14 hand joints, not 59 physical robot joints
VAE motion window of 10 frames differs from VLA action chunk of 40 steps
Rollout-aware generator distillation concerns student denoising states, not environment reward optimization
Tracking ten-seed runs vary evaluation trajectory noise; not ten independent policy training runs
Full-system comparison changes both the interface and the downstream generator/tracker relative to GR00T-SONIC baselines
Generation benchmark uses 20 denoising steps for both Kimodo and SP-MGM; smoothness remains worse than Kimodo
Component inference rates do not establish full-system latency or body control frequency
Real tasks have 80 real demonstrations each and no real-world baseline table
192 GPU-hours concerns SP-GMT tracking training, not all upstream pretraining or whole-system cost

licenses.framework_weights_data: Not established; do not infer from website availability
